title: Nice app for logging streaks
body: I really like this app compared to the ones that don’t let you record the things you forgot to add the day before.
author: IrinaHelena

title: Recommendations
body: Very nice tracker app with plenty of tracker options and good visual feedback. Definitely my favourite. If I could suggest some improvement, perhaps some spice to the design? App is clean and easy to use - but could have a bit of personality!
author: alks dkqwjhL KJH Lkjhds lk

title: Best Habit Tracker!
body: Unlike most habit trackers this one gives me proper statistics and data. I’m loving it.
author: MattiLammikko

title: Unstable app
body:
I tried to save weight 97.0, but looks like .0 was too much for app, since after that it shut down itself immediately after turn on.

There goes my 3 months data:(
